text.en: The campus shuttle to town stops at 6pm, and your tutorial ends at 6:30. Town is a forty-minute walk along the coast road.
text.zu: I-shuttle yasekhampasi eya edolobheni iyama ngo-6 kusihlwa, futhi ithuthorial yakho iphela ngo-6:30. Idolobha likude ngemizuzu engamashumi amane ngezinyawo emgwaqweni wasogwini.

outcome.en: Forty minutes in the dark, in the wind. You don't want to do that every week.
outcome.zu: Imizuzu engamashumi amane ebumnyameni, emoyeni. Awufuni ukwenza lokho masonto onke.

label.en: Arrange a lift in the group

outcome.en: Two classmates drive in from town. You share petrol money and never miss the tutorial again.
outcome.zu: Abafunda nawe ababili bashayela besuka edolobheni. Nabelana ngemali kaphethiloli futhi awuphinde uphuthelwe yithuthorial.

outcome.en: The Day Students' Room has a list for the 7pm shuttle, which only runs when students book it. You book every Tuesday.
outcome.zu: Igumbi Labafundi Abagibelayo linohlu lwe-shuttle yango-7, ehamba kuphela uma abafundi beyibhukha. Ubhukha njalo ngoLwesibili.

tip.en: Ask what runs on request. Late shuttles and security escorts often only run when someone books them.
tip.zu: Buza ukuthi yini ehamba ngokucela. Ama-shuttle asebusuku nokuphelezelwa kuvame ukuhamba kuphela uma othile ebhukha.
